facts.text: Located in a remote corner of Chobe desert.
The lodge is situated in the heart of the Savute Channel.
facts.excerpt: Situated in the heart of the Savute Channel

facts.text: The lodge is a 50 minute flight from Maun.
The lodge is a 40 minute flight from Kasane.
The lodge has an airstrip and helipad.
The tented rooms are raised on a bamboo platform and have a four-poster bed.
facts.excerpt: Raised on a bamboo platform, venture inside to discover a four-poster bed

facts.text: Campfire dining is offered.
Bush dining and sundowners are offered.
In-room and private dining are offered.
The lodge has a heated swimming pool.
The lodge has a spa tent.
The lodge has a lookout hide over a watering hole.
The lodge has a reference library.
The lodge offers children's amenities and activities.
Meals and drinks are all-inclusive.
A minimum of 2 game viewing activities per day is included.
facts.excerpt: Minimum 2 game viewing activities per day

facts.text: San Bushmen created paintings in the ancient rocks of the hills near the lodge over 2000 years ago.
facts.excerpt: created paintings in the ancient rocks of the hills near our lodge over 2000 years ago

facts.text: The Savute channel started flowing again in 2008 and goes from dry to wet unpredictably.
facts.excerpt: the Savute channel started flowing again in 2008 and goes from dry to wet unpredictably

facts.text: Savute is the Setswana word for unpredictable.
facts.excerpt: unpredictable being the translation for the Setswana word, Savute

facts.text: A permanent watering hole lies directly in front of the lodge.
facts.excerpt: a permanent watering hole directly in front of our lodge
